proposed_question.text: In the Revised National Plumbing Code of the Philippines definition, one fixture unit is equivalent to what flow rate?

rationale.correct: Section 207.8 states that one fixture unit is equivalent to a rate of flow at 28.3 liters per minute (1 cu. ft./minute).

distractors.A: 10.7 is not the cited plumbing fixture-unit equivalent; the local fixture-unit definition points to 28.3 L/min.

rationale.takeaway: Fixture unit is a load/flow scale; in the cited definition, one fixture unit equals 28.3 L/min.
